title: Annual Report of the Parochial Church Council for the Year Ended 31 December 2026

headings.text: Annual Report of the Parochial Church Council for the Year Ended 31 December 2026

key_sentences: The Parochial Church Council works with the incumbent in promoting the whole mission of the Church in the parish, pastoral, evangelistic, social and ecumenical.
Holy Trinity held 312 services during the year, including a weekly said service in the care home on Mill Lane.
Average Sunday attendance rose from 86 to 94 adults, with between 15 and 25 children at the monthly family service.
The repair of the north aisle roof was completed in September, two weeks ahead of schedule and within budget.
Total income for the year was £148,730, of which £41,200 was given for the roof appeal and is held as a restricted fund.
The restricted deficit was met from the roof fund balance brought forward from 2025.
At the end of the year unrestricted reserves stood at £38,940, which meets this policy.
